## GraphQLSchema

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLSchema = {
  /**
   * All types of the schema, including the introspection types themselves
   */
  types: GraphQLType[];
};
```

GraphQL introspection data (__Schema), starting with the value of the
"__schema" key.

## GraphQLType

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLType = GraphQLScalarType | GraphQLObjectType | GraphQLInterfaceType | GraphQLUnionType | GraphQLEnumType | GraphQLInputObjectType;
```

One of the named types of the schema, discriminated by "kind". The members
not applying to a kind are present as null, so they can be accessed without
narrowing first:

```ts
 // GraphQLField[] | null
 const fields = type.fields

 if (type.kind === "OBJECT")
 {
     // GraphQLField[]
     const fields = type.fields
 }
```

## GraphQLNamedTypeBase

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLNamedTypeBase = {
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
};
```

## GraphQLScalarType

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLScalarType = GraphQLNamedTypeBase & {
  kind: "SCALAR";
  fields: null;
  inputFields: null;
  interfaces: null;
  enumValues: null;
  possibleTypes: null;
};
```

Scalar type (graphql.schema.GraphQLScalarType). Has none of the kind
specific members.

## GraphQLObjectType

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLObjectType = GraphQLNamedTypeBase & {
  kind: "OBJECT";
  /**
   * Fields of the object, deprecated ones included
   */
  fields: GraphQLField[];
  inputFields: null;
  /**
   * Interfaces implemented by this object
   */
  interfaces: GraphQLNamedTypeRef[];
  enumValues: null;
  possibleTypes: null;
};
```

Object type (graphql.schema.GraphQLObjectType)

## GraphQLInterfaceType

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLInterfaceType = GraphQLNamedTypeBase & {
  kind: "INTERFACE";
  /**
   * Fields of the interface, deprecated ones included
   */
  fields: GraphQLField[];
  inputFields: null;
  /**
   * Interfaces implemented by this interface
   */
  interfaces: GraphQLNamedTypeRef[];
  enumValues: null;
  /**
   * Object types implementing this interface
   */
  possibleTypes: GraphQLNamedTypeRef[];
};
```

Interface type (graphql.schema.GraphQLInterfaceType)

## GraphQLField

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLField = {
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  args: GraphQLInputValue[];
  type: GraphQLTypeRef;
  isDeprecated: boolean;
  deprecationReason: string | null;
};
```

Field of an object or interface type (graphql.schema.GraphQLFieldDefinition)

## GraphQLInputValue

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLInputValue = {
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  type: GraphQLTypeRef;
  /**
   * Default value as GraphQL literal source, null if there is none
   */
  defaultValue: string | null;
};
```

Argument of a field (graphql.schema.GraphQLArgument) or field of an input
object (graphql.schema.GraphQLInputObjectField). Both are introspected as
__InputValue.


Value of an enum type (graphql.schema.GraphQLEnumValueDefinition)

## GraphQLTypeRef

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLTypeRef = GraphQLNamedTypeRef | GraphQLModifiedTypeRef;
```

Reference to the type of a field, argument or input field, i.e. a named type
potentially wrapped in LIST / NON_NULL modifiers.

## GraphQLNamedTypeRef

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLNamedTypeRef = {
  kind: GraphQLNamedTypes;
  name: string;
  /**
   * Named types wrap nothing. Missing on the innermost level (see
   * GraphQLModifiedTypeRef.ofType).
   */
  ofType?: null;
};
```

Reference to one of the named types in GraphQLSchema.types.

## GraphQLModifiedTypeRef

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLModifiedTypeRef = GraphQLList | GraphQLNonNull;
```

One of the two type modifiers (graphql.schema.GraphQLModifiedType)

## GraphQLList

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLList = {
  kind: "LIST";
  name: null;
  /**
   * The wrapped type.
   *
   * Missing if the modifier sits on the innermost of the four nesting levels
   * the introspection query selects. Only reachable with more than four
   * modifiers on one type, e.g. [[String!]!]!
   */
  ofType?: GraphQLTypeRef;
};
```

LIST modifier wrapping another type reference. Has no name of its own.

## GraphQLNonNull

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLNonNull = {
  kind: "NON_NULL";
  name: null;
  /**
   * The wrapped type. Missing on the innermost nesting level, see
   * GraphQLListTypeRef.ofType
   */
  ofType?: GraphQLTypeRef;
};
```

NON_NULL modifier wrapping another type reference. Has no name of its own.

## GraphQLNamedTypes

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLNamedTypes = "SCALAR" | "OBJECT" | "INTERFACE" | "UNION" | "ENUM" | "INPUT_OBJECT";
```

Kind of a named type, i.e. one of the graphql.schema.GraphQLNamedType
implementations.

## GraphQLModifiedTypes

<span class="api-kind">type</span>

```ts
type GraphQLModifiedTypes = "LIST" | "NON_NULL";
```

Kind of a type modifier, i.e. one of the graphql.schema.GraphQLModifiedType
implementations wrapping another type.

## findType()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function findType(name: string): GraphQLType;
```

Returns the named type of the given name.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `name` | GraphQL type name  |

**Returns** the type

**Throws** if the schema has no type of that name

## objectFields()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function objectFields(type: string): GraphQLField[];
```

The fields of the given object type.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `type` | GraphQL type name  |

**Returns** the fields, in schema order

**Throws** if the schema has no type of that name, or it is not an object type

## unwrapAll()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function unwrapAll(type: GraphQLTypeRef): GraphQLNamedTypeRef;
```

Unwraps all LIST and NON_NULL modifiers off the given type reference and
returns the named type at the heart of it.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `type` | GraphQL type reference |

**Returns** the named type reference wrapped by the modifiers

## unwrapNonNull()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function unwrapNonNull(type: GraphQLTypeRef): GraphQLTypeRef;
```

Unwraps a NON_NULL modifier off the given type reference, if there is one.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `type` | GraphQL type reference |

**Returns** the wrapped type, or the type itself if it is nullable

## isListType()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function isListType(type: GraphQLTypeRef): boolean;
```

Returns true if the given type reference is a list or a non-null list.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `type` | GraphQL type reference |

**Returns** true if list

## isNonNull()

<span class="api-kind">function</span>

```ts
declare function isNonNull(type: GraphQLTypeRef): boolean;
```

Returns true if the given type reference is non-null, i.e. a value of that
type is guaranteed to be present.

**Parameters**

| | |
|---|---|
| `type` | GraphQL type reference |

**Returns** true if non-null
